verdict.rationale: v0 documents connecting projects to third-party services from the builder, with secure storage for API keys and full-stack app scaffolding. The named integrations are databases, Supabase and AI providers; payments and email providers are never mentioned, and server-side functions are only implied by 'full-stack'. missing for 10: evidence of payment integrations (e.g. Stripe), evidence of email integrations, explicit docs on authoring server-side functions/API routes in the builder, independent hands-on corroboration of backend integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add server-side functions and third-party integrations like payments and email from the builder

citations.quote: Connect your project to third-party services to give your Project access to external data and functionality.
Available integrations include databases like Upstash for Redis and Neon for Serverless Postgres, backend services like Supabase, and AI model providers.
Build with your favorite tools and APIs. Automatic integration, no accounts required.
Securely store sensitive information like API keys, tokens, and other credentials.
Quickly scaffold full-stack apps or components following best practices and modern standards.
